_readme: HOW TO ADD / CHANGE PHOTOS: 1) Upload the photo to Cloudinary. 2) Copy the part of its delivery URL that comes after '/upload/' (e.g. 'v1781416390/MPEG_-_12_cpgws8.jpg'). 3) Paste it as the 'id' of a new entry below, with an 'alt' description and a 'caption'. 4) Set 'featured: true' on up to 3 photos to show them on the homepage. 5) Add a new category block to start a new gallery section. That's it — no other files need editing.
